newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power sells computer services unit. [corrected 09:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power sells computer services unit. [corrected 09:00 GMT]

text.p: British utility Scottish Power Plc said on Monday it had sold Southern Water's computer services business I T Southern for 10.8 million stg to facilities management group CFM.
(Scottish Power corrects name of unit to Southern Water from Scottish Water)

Scottish Power, which bought Southern Water last year, said the disposal was part of its programme to sell the latter's subsidiaries which were considered unnecessary for its core water and waste water business.
